prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 51.2 °C (65% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 57.9 °C (49% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 56.1 °C (56% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.67 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.47 s (2% above healthy). A small switching delay appears during the main pressure transient, reflecting early valve degradation.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 3.30 l/min (50% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 800 W·min/l (109% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 30.4 % (48% below healthy). Significant reduction in delivered volume flow at nominal electrical power indicates severe internal pump slippage.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 56.8 bar (22% above healthy). Hydraulic dampening shows early wear with mildly heightened ripple during load transitions.

tslm_prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.6 °C (69% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.9 °C (51% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.2 °C (59% above healthy). Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.40 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.64 s (within 2% of healthy). Directional valve actuates cleanly with no discernible switching hesitation.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 3.29 l/min (50% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 802 W·min/l (109% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 30.3 % (48% below healthy). High power-to-flow ratio demonstrates extensive internal leakage across the pump chambers.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 56.6 bar (21% above healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.
